name: Kitamura Yuusaku
source:
Yuusaku is a male student in Ryuuji's class, and is his best friend. He is the president of the student council, the class representative, and captain of the boy's softball club at school.
[spoiler] During his time as the vice-president of the student council, he eventually falls in love with the student council president, Kanou Sumire.[/spoiler]
